name: Ethotoin

similar.name: Oxyphenbutazone Anhydrous
problems: Pulled from the market in United States and 7 other countries, first in 1984 — for blood problems and serious skin reactions

summary: A small computer model, not tests on people, gave Ethotoin a medium risk score of 56 for the liver and a low risk score of 40 for the heart [M]. Ethotoin does not list any direct problems of its own in the records [1][2]. However, a similar drug called Oxyphenbutazone Anhydrous was pulled from the market in the United States and seven other countries starting in 1984 because it caused blood issues and severe skin reactions [3].
